/** * Transcribes the provided audio stream with the specified options. * *

Sample

* * 
     * client.transcribe(new TranscriptionOptions("https://example.com/audio.wav"))
     *     .subscribe(result -> System.out.println(result.getCombinedPhrases().get(0).getText()));
     *
* * @param options the transcription options including audio file details or audio URL * @throws IllegalArgumentException thrown if parameters fail the validation. * @throws HttpResponseException thrown if the request is rejected by server. * @throws ClientAuthenticationException thrown if the request is rejected by server on status code 401. * @throws ResourceNotFoundException thrown if the request is rejected by server on status code 404. * @throws ResourceModifiedException thrown if the request is rejected by server on status code 409. * @throws RuntimeException all other wrapped checked exceptions if the request fails to be sent. * @return the result of the transcribe operation on successful completion of {@link Mono}. */ @ServiceMethod(returns = ReturnType.SINGLE) public Mono transcribe(TranscriptionOptions options) { return transcribeWithResponse(options, null).map(Response::getValue); }

/** * Transcribes the provided audio stream with the specified options and returns the full HTTP * response, useful for inspecting status code and headers (for example the * {@code x-ms-request-id} header used in support escalations). * *

Sample

* * 
     * client.transcribeWithResponse(new TranscriptionOptions("https://example.com/audio.wav"), new RequestOptions())
     *     .subscribe(response -> System.out.println("Status: " + response.getStatusCode()));
     *
* * @param options the transcription options including audio file details or audio URL * @param requestOptions the options to configure the HTTP request before HTTP client sends it * @throws IllegalArgumentException thrown if parameters fail the validation. * @throws HttpResponseException thrown if the request is rejected by server. * @throws ClientAuthenticationException thrown if the request is rejected by server on status code 401. * @throws ResourceNotFoundException thrown if the request is rejected by server on status code 404. * @throws ResourceModifiedException thrown if the request is rejected by server on status code 409. * @throws RuntimeException all other wrapped checked exceptions if the request fails to be sent. * @return the response containing the result of the transcribe operation on successful completion of {@link Mono}. */ @ServiceMethod(returns = ReturnType.SINGLE) public Mono> transcribeWithResponse(TranscriptionOptions options, RequestOptions requestOptions) { AudioFileDetails audio = options.getFileDetails(); RequestOptions effectiveRequestOptions = requestOptions == null ? new RequestOptions() : requestOptions; return transcribeWithResponseInternal( new MultipartFormDataHelper(effectiveRequestOptions).serializeJsonField("definition", options) .serializeFileField("audio", audio == null ? null : audio.getContent(), audio == null ? null : audio.getContentType(), audio == null ? null : audio.getFilename()) .end() .getRequestBody(), effectiveRequestOptions).map( response -> new SimpleResponse<>(response, response.getValue().toObject(TranscriptionResult.class))); }

/** * Transcribes the provided audio stream with the specified options. * *

Sample

* * 
     * TranscriptionResult result = client.transcribe(new TranscriptionOptions("https://example.com/audio.wav"));
     *
* * @param options the transcription options including audio file details or audio URL * @throws IllegalArgumentException thrown if parameters fail the validation. * @throws HttpResponseException thrown if the request is rejected by server. * @throws ClientAuthenticationException thrown if the request is rejected by server on status code 401. * @throws ResourceNotFoundException thrown if the request is rejected by server on status code 404. * @throws ResourceModifiedException thrown if the request is rejected by server on status code 409. * @throws RuntimeException all other wrapped checked exceptions if the request fails to be sent. * @return the result of the transcribe operation. */ @ServiceMethod(returns = ReturnType.SINGLE) public TranscriptionResult transcribe(TranscriptionOptions options) { return transcribeWithResponse(options, null).getValue(); }

proposals.subtype: Retype millisecond duration getters to java.time.Duration
proposals.explanation: The script calls customizeDurationGetter for TranscriptionResult, TranscribedPhrase and TranscribedWord. That helper imports Duration and requests that each getDuration return Duration.ofMillis(this.duration), with a Duration return type and matching Javadoc.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: SpeechTranscriptionCustomization extends Customization and explicitly rewrites getter AST return types, bodies and documentation.

proposals.subtype: Convert millisecond offsets to Duration in model getters
proposals.explanation: customizeOffsetGetter is invoked for TranscribedPhrase and TranscribedWord and changes getOffset to return Duration.ofMillis(this.offset), retaining the getter name and requesting corresponding documentation.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The customization script explicitly sets the model getters' types and bodies through customizeAst.

proposals.subtype: Require an explicit enable flag and preserve it in model JSON
proposals.explanation: customizeDiarizationOptionsToJson removes the no-arg constructor, adds a public boolean-enabled constructor and rewrites JSON methods. Serialization writes non-null enabled and maxSpeakers values; deserialization starts with enabled=false, reads nullable enabled/maxSpeakers and skips unknown fields. The captured model constructor corroborates direct storage of the supplied boolean. The script also updates enable-related documentation rather than deriving enablement from maxSpeakers.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The script explicitly adds/removes constructor AST nodes and replaces serialization bodies; the corresponding concrete model constructor is supplied.

proposals.subtype: Initialize a hidden enable flag and explicitly serialize enhanced-mode options
proposals.explanation: customizeEnhancedModeOptions finds the no-arg constructor, removes its Generated annotation and sets enabled=true; the captured constructor matches this initialization. The script removes isEnabled/setEnabled methods and replaces toJson with explicit enabled, task, targetLanguage and prompt-array writes. This establishes a constructor default and requested public-surface/serialization edits, not that every deserialized instance must retain enabled=true.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The Customization subclass explicitly removes a generation annotation, rewrites the constructor and JSON body and removes named accessors, with a matching concrete constructor excerpt.

The handwritten customization subclass directly requests removal of the named TranscriptionContent model source file, which is a hide-generated-surface edit. Acceptance is limited to that explicit removeFile call, not proof that published artifacts omit the type.
